'''Alaris''' was a large [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] located within the [[Alaris Expanse]] in the outer arm of the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]],<ref name="GB" /> a part of the [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor sector]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] had eight [[Moon/Legends|moons]] and held the sixth [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position around the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Kashyyyk (star)/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="TEA" />

The size of Alaris hid one of its small moons, [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]], from [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] view, meaning that the moon was [[Colonist/Legends|uncolonized]] for [[Time/Legends|eons]] despite its extensive resources.<ref name="GB" /> Sometime between [[59 BBY/Legends|59 BBY]] and [[56 BBY/Legends|56 BBY]]<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the [[Colonist/Legends|colonization]] of [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]], and the databank in ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' states that the negotiations to colonize the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] took place over a twenty [[Standard year/Legends|year]] period after its [[Discovery of Alaris Prime|discovery]]. The discovery of Alaris Prime must have therefore occurred between [[59 BBY/Legends|59 BBY]] and [[56 BBY/Legends|56 BBY]].</ref> [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] from the nearby planet [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] [[Discovery of Alaris Prime|discovered]] Alaris Prime and [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonized]] it twenty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later,<ref name="GB" /> also claiming the other seven moons of Alaris.<ref name="TEA" /> The Alaris colonies utilized middle-period [[Krorral]], an [[Architect/Legends|architectural]] style involving domed structures.<ref name="GATORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Alaris first appeared in the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'', in the introduction to the first level of the Wookiee tutorial campaign.<ref name="GB" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the planet, along with the rest of the Kashyyyk [[Star system/Legends|system]], in grid square P-9.<ref name="TEA" />
